title: Go ships as the fourth LanguageSpec registry entry (tree-sitter-go 0.23, module-path import resolution)
context: Roadmap dec_c3c9d0e191 named Go as the next language once the registry path was proven by Python. Shipped in commit 14242c1: one LanguageSpec entry + tree-sitter-go, no parse.ts engine changes.
decision: Add Go via the registry contract: tree-sitter-go pinned to the 0.23 line (matches the sibling grammars' ABI against the tree-sitter 0.21.1 runtime; 0.25 exists but is not needed), prebuilds verified for win32/linux/darwin x64+arm64, loaded through the per-process temp-copy isolation (added to NATIVE_PACKAGES and the preloaded-binding guard regex). Kind mapping: struct type_specs classify as class, interface type_specs as interface, other type_specs AND type_alias nodes as type — `type X = Y` is a distinct type_alias node in the grammar, not a type_spec. Package-qualified calls (fmt.Println) are Go's dominant call form and land as member calls, so a stdlib-name allowlist (GO_BUILTIN_METHODS) filters false edges. Imports resolve via a dedicated resolveGoImport: strip the go.mod module path to an exact package directory, or try the spec as a repo-relative directory when no go.mod exists; stdlib/external imports resolve to null.
consequences: The specific-before-generic type_spec query pattern order is load-bearing: parse.ts keeps the FIRST classification per node id (dec_b4b61b9b02), so reordering the struct/interface patterns after the generic @type.def silently reclassifies every struct as kind type.
No toleratedErrorScopes declared: Go stays strictly fail-closed until a real grammar false positive is proven (the dec_7c4cf74bb2 bar).
resolveGoImport does no suffix guessing — an external module that shadows a repo directory name resolves to null rather than fabricating a depends_on edge.
The roadmap's Dart-deferred-pending-demand half remains as recorded in dec_c3c9d0e191's history.
alternatives_rejected: tree-sitter-go 0.25 (latest): the 0.23 line matches the ABI expectations of the pinned tree-sitter 0.21.1 runtime that typescript/python 0.23 grammars already prove out; bumping the grammar line alone risks a native ABI mismatch for zero feature gain.

Suffix-matching import paths against repo directories without go.mod: fabricates depends_on edges when an external import's tail collides with a repo directory name; a wrong edge is worse than a missing one.
Classifying all Go type declarations as kind type: hides structs and interfaces from blast radius and conformance predicates that key on class/interface kinds.
